Hi {{firstName}},

I wanted to follow up on my note from a few days ago about bringing Diablo Sugar Free to {{market}}. We would be glad to send you samples, along with our pricing and logistics details, so you can judge the fit for your customers.

Would a brief 10-minute call next week work for you, or is there someone else on your team I should speak to?

Best regards,
{{sender_name}}
{{sender_title}}
Diablo Sugar Free
{{sender_website}}
{{sender_phone}}


--
Diablo Sugar Free (B Healthy Ltd, London). If you would rather not hear from us, reply "no thanks" and we will not contact you again. Privacy notice: {{privacy_url}}
